uncertainty.rule: Estimate per-candidate score uncertainty from independent seeds/model replicates and positive-conformer variability; compare all margins to the propagated standard error. A raw score difference without an uncertainty estimate cannot pass.
uncertainty.decision_metric: lower 95% confidence bound of target minus worst-negative selectivity margin
uncertainty.pass_condition: lower 95% confidence bound > 0 and standardized margin >= 2.0

rf3_metrics.effective_uncertainty: For every pairwise delta, sigma_eff is max(propagated standard error across three independent seeds, half the absolute 7N2O-vs-7N2N Q difference, 0.02).
rf3_metrics.confidence_rule: Every required raw effect must also exceed 2*sigma_eff; multiplicity is handled as an intersection rule, so every mandatory negative must pass.

automatic_rejection: Any required structure or counterfactual is missing or fails provenance audit.
Interface is dominated by contacts outside beta CDR3.
Candidate fails on either AS4.2 experimental conformer.
Worst mandatory-negative separation is not larger than scoring uncertainty.
Predicted interaction survives F98A or broad hotspot alanine perturbation.
Complex confidence or monomer-fold confidence is below the selected model's preregistered threshold.
